summary: Iteration_2 frontend retest against http://localhost:3000 in mobile viewport 390x844 with live SafeBase backend. 6 of 8 PRD items PASS, 1 PARTIAL (admin), 1 FAIL (logout). Trades accent fix VERIFIED: home + profile + CTAs render in rgb(255,166,48) = #FFA630 (13 hits in DOM color frequency scan); visually distinct from the admin warning yellow rgb(255,204,0) = #FFCC00. Register 'Unexpected text node' RN-web error is GONE (0 hits across console). Profile screen now exposes testID='industry-switcher' for the single-industry trades demo user and displays the 'SINGLE-INDUSTRY WORKSPACE' hint with a Trades & Construction row + amber dot + checkmark. Capture form /capture/lone-worker-checkin submits cleanly via offline-queue.web.ts → no red-box error, no [data-testid=lone-worker-error] surfaced. Hospitality home accent VERIFIED #E11D48 (rgb(225,29,72), 12 hits). Pre-login authority blue #002FA7 confirmed on login, register, AND forgot-password (forgot button testID is 'forgot-submit', not 'forgot-submit-button'). Admin login button bg is #FFCC00 as expected. CRITICAL REGRESSION: tapping testID='profile-logout-button' does NOTHING on web — Alert.alert is a no-op in react-native-web and no Alert→window.confirm shim exists in the codebase, so the destructive 'Sign out' button never fires. The handoff note claims this was implemented; it is NOT. Same root cause means the Capture form success Alert ('Submitted' / 'Saved') also fails to call its OK→router.back() callback, so users are left staring at the filled form with no confirmation. RN-web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (x6) still emitted by react-navigation internals (library-level, carried over from iter_1).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping testID='profile-logout-button' has no effect on web preview. Implementation calls Alert.alert('Sign out', ...) and routes the actual logout through the destructive button's onPress callback. React-native-web ships Alert.alert as a no-op (no native bridge, no window.confirm shim) so neither the confirm dialog nor the onPress→deregisterPush/disableBiometric/logout/router.replace('/login') chain ever runs. Result: URL stays at /profile and the user is stuck logged in. Iteration_2 handoff says 'Alert.alert → window.confirm' is implemented, but grep finds zero polyfill/shim/window.confirm references under /app/frontend/{src,app}. Recommend a small web shim like `if (Platform.OS === 'web') Alert.alert = (title, msg, buttons) => { const ok = window.confirm(`${title}\n\n${msg ?? ''}`); const destructive = buttons?.find(b => b.style === 'destructive') ?? buttons?.find(b => b.text !== 'Cancel'); if (ok && destructive?.onPress) destructive.onPress(); }` installed once in app/_layout.tsx (or src/lib/alert.web.ts via .web.ts resolution).

ui_bugs.component: Capture screens — success Alert (src/components/CaptureFormScreen.tsx:83-89; also app/incident/new.tsx, app/risk/new.tsx, app/settings/*)
ui_bugs.issue: Same root cause as the logout bug. Successful submit calls `Alert.alert('Submitted', successMessage, [{ text: 'OK', onPress: () => router.back() }])` which never fires on web — no toast, no navigation, the form just clears its submitting state and stays on screen. Functionally the POST does fly (offline-queue.web.ts → apiRequest succeeds), but the user gets no acknowledgement and no way back except the in-screen Back chevron. Web-side Alert shim (see above) would fix every Alert.alert call site at once.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end logout flow is broken on web preview because Alert.alert is a no-op. Verified by clicking 'profile-logout-button' twice; page.url remained 'http://localhost:3000/profile' and no `dialog` event fired in Playwright.
Submit network call succeeds (no red box) but the success Alert never resolves its OK callback on web, so the form does not navigate back. Same Alert.alert root cause.

issues: RN-web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still emits 6× during a normal navigation pass. As flagged in iter_1 the source is react-navigation internals — a library-level fix, not actionable inside this repo. Recommend pinning to a react-navigation version that has migrated or filing/upstreaming the bug; harmless functionally but pollutes the console for the next QA pass.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web's Alert.alert is a no-op (no native modal, no window.confirm fallback). Any code that depends on a destructive button's onPress callback — sign out, capture submit success, incident-saved, risk-saved, settings 'Saved' — silently breaks on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:60-74 and /app/frontend/src/components/CaptureFormScreen.tsx:83-89. Fix: install a one-time web Alert shim in app/_layout.tsx (or create src/lib/alert.web.ts with a Platform.OS === 'web' override) that maps to window.confirm() and dispatches the destructive/OK button's onPress.

action_items: CRITICAL: Implement a react-native-web Alert.alert → window.confirm shim so the Profile Sign-out destructive button actually logs the user out (also unblocks every other Alert.alert callback across the app — capture/incident/risk/settings). See suggested patch in frontend_issues.ui_bugs[0].

Re-verify the logout flow + capture-form acknowledgement once the Alert shim is in place; iteration_3 should confirm /profile → click Sign out → window.confirm → OK → redirect to /login, and /capture/lone-worker-checkin submit → 'Submitted' toast → router.back() to the Capture index.
(Carry-over) Migrate any in-repo pointerEvents prop usage to style.pointerEvents, or pin react-navigation to a version where this is fixed, to clear the 6× SDK 54 deprecation warning per pageview.

Note for QA: the forgot-password submit button's testID is `forgot-submit` (not `forgot-submit-button` as some other screens use). Either align the naming or document — currently inconsistent with `login-submit-button` / `register-submit-button` / `admin-login-submit-button`.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:60-74 — Alert.alert with a destructive-button onPress is the ONLY logout path on Profile. On web this means logout is unreachable. Either install an Alert shim globally or guard with Platform.OS === 'web' and call window.confirm() inline.

src/components/CaptureFormScreen.tsx:83-89 — same Alert.alert pattern, success path can't acknowledge or navigate back on web. Strongly suggest a global shim rather than per-screen Platform.select to avoid drift.
src/theme/colors.ts:35 — trades=#FFA630 ✓; hospitality=#E11D48 ✓; the warning yellow #FFCC00 and the new trades amber #FFA630 are visually distinct in screenshots — colour contract restored.
app/register.tsx — whitespace text-node bug from iter_1 is gone; no `Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.` in the console for the full register pageview.
